whisper.label: Whisper Large-V3
whisper.text:
My name is Rita Jimenez.
This is my installation of portal shrines.
It comes in two parts.
The portals are the projections of digital collages that I make.
The portals represent the idea of escaping into an ethereal space digitally, but they're
projected onto these shrines that I've made for the portals.
Each shrine has light reflective materials of mirrors, gels, iridescents.
It goes in a form of the rainbow.
So each shrine starts from the center.
It's a spectrum.
And it leads up to the final shrine of prisms.
And the prisms include a live view.
So if the viewer were to be in the space, they're not only in the shrines, but they
become a part of it.
So the prisms, not only can you see through them and create this kaleidoscopic view, but
the light that's shining on it also casts prismatic light.
So it's all there.
It's all connected.
I'm drawn to light itself and what it can do physically.
It definitely has a lot of spiritual aspects that contribute to the concepts, but anything,
any object, any material that elicits light or reflects or refracts or diffracts, it's
essential to the installation because what it's doing adds to it.
It's a very powerful tool.
